about.title: Frontend engineering for AI-native products
bio: I'm a senior frontend engineer with 5+ years building scalable SaaS platforms and AI-powered products. I focus on what users actually notice: fast, responsive and accessible interfaces that stay easy to use as the product grows.

At MaxIQ I architect the frontend for AI agents and real-time collaboration. I built the Agents Builder, the Skills Builder and the Agentic Workflow Builder, which turns natural-language goals into schedulable multi-step workflows, plus a ChatGPT-style assistant with token streaming, voice input and rich answers. I also build agent UI on the AG-UI protocol with agentic generative UI, so agents render live, interactive components instead of plain text.

Before that I was a full-stack engineer at Namshi, building its marketplace from zero to one and onboarding brands like Adidas and Victoria's Secret at scale. That backend experience is why I design frontends around real data and real failure modes.

experiences.summary: Own the frontend architecture of MaxIQ's (formerly Gyaan.ai) AI SaaS platform: its flagship AI features, the real-time layer underneath them, and the core product modules.
highlights: Architected and shipped the Agents Builder, Skills Builder and Agentic Workflow Builder; the workflow builder turns natural-language goals into editable, schedulable multi-step agent workflows with live step previews and delivery actions.
Built agent interfaces on the AG-UI protocol with agentic generative UI, so agents stream their steps, tool calls and state into the product and render interactive components instead of plain text.

Owned a ChatGPT-style AI assistant with token streaming, streaming voice-to-text input and structured answers with charts, tables, citations and GFM, on reusable controllers and TanStack Query that also power the Agents, Skills and Workflow builders.
Built the shared real-time layer that streams LLM responses over WebSockets secured with short-lived tickets, with automatic reconnection and stalled-stream recovery.
Delivered the flagship Pipeline Conversion Analytics feature with interactive Nivo drill-downs, plus an admin interface that improved conversion and waterfall visibility.
Engineered a real-time Unified Workspace and revamped Home, Views, Emails and Calendar, improving performance with code splitting, lazy loading and memoization.

experiences.summary: Helped architect and build Namshi's marketplace platform from zero to one, working with the PM, OMS, SRE and Offering teams on scalable partner integration workflows.
highlights: Engineered the marketplace UI with automated catalog ingestion and product lifecycle systems, onboarding brands like Adidas, Victoria's Secret, CampusSutra and LIWA at scale.
Led frontend development for catalog management, analytics dashboards and the CMS, on reusable component libraries built for complex merchant workflows.
Built REST APIs and background processing services, and tuned queries and indexes for high-volume catalog workflows.
Improved performance and delivery speed with code splitting, memoization and leaner Redux state flows, and reviewed PRs and mentored new engineers.

projects.title: Konnect
projects.tagline: A full-stack social app, live in real time.
projects.description: Photo posts, follows, likes, comments, real-time chat and live notifications, with Google and GitHub sign-in. Built from scratch on Next.js 16 and Supabase: a static shell prerenders with Partial Prerendering while personal data streams in without layout shift, and Postgres row-level security decides who can read and write every row.
